# Paths relative to $HOME that sync.sh copies into home/ and install.sh puts back.
# A trailing slash means a whole directory. Lines starting with # are ignored.

# Compositor: keybinds, touchpad/mouse, Num Lock, overview, gestures
# (plugins/*.toml are generated by the nafeel/* Noctalia plugins)
.config/umbriel/config.toml
.config/umbriel/noctalia.toml
.config/umbriel/plugins/

# Noctalia shell config; most of it is generated by the nafeel/* plugins below
.config/noctalia/

# Noctalia GUI settings: bar, dock, theme, enabled plugins and their settings
.local/state/noctalia/settings.toml

# My Noctalia plugins (nafeel/*): app-theming, capture, cave-abode, wallpaper-palette,
# window-switcher, idle-kit, graceful-power
.local/share/noctalia/plugins/

# Terminal (scroll multiplier, theme)
.config/foot/

# Shell: fish (CachyOS config + PATH, pure prompt settings), starship prompt
.config/fish/
.config/starship.toml

# CLI apps: fastfetch theme, neovim, fuzzel (themes come from Noctalia's templates)
.config/fastfetch/
.config/nvim/
.config/fuzzel/

# GTK 3/4: Noctalia colours, Thunar styling
.config/gtk-3.0/
.config/gtk-4.0/

# Chrome: elastic overscroll flag
.config/chrome-flags.conf

# Greeter helper (sudo, once)
.local/bin/greeter-numlock-on
